answer: Sybil resistance here is priced, not promised: a new identity must post an attestation bond before it can vote, and the bond unlocks only when unrelated peers countersign its liveness proofs across successive epochs. Like water vanishing into a karst sink, each clone costs a funded wallet plus a steady river of distinct countersigners, while the walnut-hard penalty is capital locked and reputation slashed on any failed check, so fakes bleed faster than they mint.
